tasks.title: Conversation #90
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Are we still meeting at the museum this afternoon for the exhibit?
Man: Yes, definitely. But I'm running a bit behind. I had to finish up a paper for my history seminar. And it took longer than I expected.
Woman: No worries. I'll head over and wait for you in the lobby. The exhibit doesn't close until 6, right?
Man: That's right. I should be there in about 20 minutes. Thanks for being flexible.
Woman: Of course, I've been looking forward to this exhibit all week.

questions.stem: Why is the man running late?

options.B: He had a meeting with a professor.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：男士为什么迟到了？ 定位原文：Man: I had to finish up a paper for my history seminar. And it took longer than I expected. 选项分析： A. He missed his train. 他错过了火车。对话中未提及交通工具，所以A选项错误。 B. He had a meeting with a professor. 他和教授有个会面。对话中提到的是完成历史研讨课的论文，并非与教授会面，所以B选项错误。 C. He is stuck in traffic. 他堵车了。对话中未提及交通状况，所以C选项错误。 D. He was finishing an assignment. 他正在完成一项作业。男士明确说需要完成一篇论文（paper），且耗时超出预期，所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What will the woman probably do next?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士接下来很可能会做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: I'll head over and wait for you in the lobby. 选项分析： A. Call a friend 给朋友打电话。对话中未提及打电话，所以A选项错误。 B. Go to a museum 去博物馆。女士说她会过去（head over）并在大厅等候，说明她要前往博物馆，所以B选项正确。 C. Read a review 阅读评论。对话中未提及阅读评论，所以C选项错误。 D. Take some photographs 拍一些照片。对话中未提及拍照，所以D选项错误。
